chunks: From him, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:

Regarding a woman who died before her husband consummated the marriage with her: what is her share of the dowry, and how is her inheritance? He said: If he had designated her her dowry, she is entitled to half of the dowry, and he inherits her. And if he had not fixed a dowry for her, then she does not inherit him, and she has no dowry.

key_terms.أَمَهَّرَهَا: He designated/set for her the dowry

ai.seo_question: What are the dowry and inheritance rights of a wife who dies before consummation of marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfabar clarifies the distinction between 'specified dowry' (mahr al-musamma) and 'fixed dowry' (mahr al-mithl) in the event of pre-consummation death, establishing that inheritance rights are contingent upon the prior specification of the dowry. It reflects the Shia juristic view that the marriage contract's financial obligations are fully activated by the naming of the mahr, even without physical union, thereby granting the wife half the specified amount and full inheritance status.
